focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需紧急核查CBAM申报数据
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年12月31日结束，2027年起进入正式征收阶段。近期欧委会加大对进口商季度报告的核查力度，已有中国钢铁、铝制品出口商因数据缺失或核算方法不符被要求补正。企业应立即梳理对欧出口产品含碳量、间接排放及原产国电网排放因子，确保申报数据可追溯、可验证，并评估在过渡期结束前完成供应商数据收集与第三方核证的可行性，以规避2027年起的碳成本风险。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会官网、中国商务部预警信息 · 2026.09.18
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Verify Carbon Data
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period ends on 31 December 2026, with the definitive regime starting in 2027. The European Commission has recently intensified scrutiny of importers' quarterly reports, and some Chinese steel and aluminium exporters have been asked to rectify missing data or non-compliant calculation methods. Companies should immediately map the embedded emissions, indirect emissions and grid emission factors of their EU-bound products, ensure traceability and verifiability of reported data, and assess the feasibility of completing supplier data collection and third-party verification before the transitional period closes, so as to mitigate carbon cost exposure from 2027.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission; MOFCOM early-warning information · 2026.09.18

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭承认与执行中国法院商事判决，明确互惠关系认定标准
case.summary: 近期新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）在一宗中新建材买卖合同纠纷中，依据《新加坡国际商事法庭法》承认并执行了中国某中级人民法院的生效判决。法院重点审查了中新之间是否存在互惠关系，并采纳了“事实互惠”标准，即中国法院此前曾承认新加坡判决的记录可作为依据。该案为中国企业在新加坡及普通法系国家申请执行中国判决提供了重要参考，建议企业在合同中约定新加坡管辖或仲裁条款，并注意判决的终局性与程序正当性要求。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭、相关法律评论 · 2026.09
case.title_en: SICC Recognises and Enforces Chinese Commercial Judgment, Clarifying Reciprocity Test
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) recently recognised and enforced a final commercial judgment of an intermediate people's court of China in a China-Singapore building materials sale dispute under the SICC Act. The court focused on whether reciprocity existed between China and Singapore and adopted a de facto reciprocity standard, accepting evidence that a Chinese court had previously recognised a Singaporean judgment. This case offers important guidance for Chinese enterprises seeking enforcement of Chinese judgments in Singapore and common law jurisdictions. Companies are advised to include Singapore jurisdiction or arbitration clauses in contracts and to ensure finality and due process of judgments.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Commercial Court; related legal commentary · 2026.09

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动试点扩围，涉外企业数据出境合规路径进一步明晰
policy.summary: 国家网信办与广东省近期联合发布粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动便利化措施，将试点范围从金融、医疗扩展至贸易、物流、专业服务等领域，允许符合条件的企业通过“数据出境安全评估”或“标准合同”之外的新增“大湾区负面清单”机制实现数据高效流动。措施明确，列入负面清单的数据出境仍需安全评估，清单外数据可自由流动。建议大湾区涉外企业尽快对照负面清单梳理自身数据资产，建立数据分类分级台账，并利用河套、前海等试点区域的政策红利优化跨境数据架构。
policy.source: 来源：国家互联网信息办公室、广东省人民政府 · 2026.09
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Data Flow Pilot Expanded, Clarifying Compliance Paths for Foreign-Related Firms
policy.summary_en: China's Cyberspace Administration and Guangdong Province have jointly issued facilitation measures for cross-border data flows in the Greater Bay Area (GBA), expanding the pilot from finance and healthcare to trade, logistics and professional services. Eligible companies may now rely on a new GBA negative list mechanism, in addition to the existing security assessment or standard contract routes, to achieve efficient data flows. Data on the negative list still requires security assessment, while data outside the list may flow freely. Foreign-related GBA enterprises should promptly map their data assets against the negative list, establish data classification and grading ledgers, and leverage policy benefits in pilot zones such as Hetao and Qianhai to optimise cross-border data architecture.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of China; Guangdong Provincial People's Government · 2026.09

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规落地，中国企业的应对策略与合规要点
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部近期发布的对外投资审查最终规则，将半导体、人工智能、量子计算等敏感领域的对华投资纳入禁止或申报范围，并首次明确“明知”标准与尽职调查义务。中国企业在美子公司、美元基金投资架构及VIE模式均可能触发合规风险。建议：第一，立即排查现有及拟议交易是否落入禁止类或申报类；第二，在投资协议中增加“监管审批”与“分手费”条款；第三，建立内部合规台账，保留尽职调查记录；第四，对可能受限的技术合作提前设计替代方案，如转向第三国或调整交易结构。
analysis.source: 来源：美国财政部、律所实务观察 · 2026.09
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: New US Outbound Investment Rules Take Effect – Strategies and Compliance Priorities for Chinese Firms
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury's recently issued final outbound investment rules bring investments in sensitive sectors such as semiconductors, AI and quantum computing in China within prohibited or notifiable categories, and for the first time clarify the 'knowledge' standard and due diligence obligations. US subsidiaries of Chinese companies, USD fund investment structures and VIE models may all trigger compliance risks. Recommendations: first, immediately screen existing and proposed transactions against prohibited and notifiable categories; second, include 'regulatory approval' and 'break fee' clauses in investment agreements; third, establish internal compliance ledgers and retain due diligence records; fourth, design alternative arrangements in advance for potentially restricted technology cooperation, such as shifting to third countries or adjusting deal structures.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Department of the Treasury; law firm practice observations · 2026.09
